summary: Two slow tests run fewer redundant cases: the envelope-delivery test checks its 30 distinct cases exactly once instead of 256 random draws, and the SLO prefix matrix skips cases that admit a claim sequence it already tested.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to restore the random cases and the full matrix.
